flags.summary: Asked directly whether the programme could fail, the rep gave an absolute guarantee of results that goes far beyond the written +8 kg performance guarantee, sworn on his mother, minutes before the prospect read the contract's medical disclaimer and no-refunds clause aloud.
evidence: so you're swearing by this, you're saying this, you will definitely get results if you, if you, if I stick with this program, right? ... Like I swear on my mother.
So you're saying if you follow everything, there's, there's no chances this can fail. ... No way.
if you follow everything to the T, you will add at least eight kilograms to your initial baseline weight of the kettlebell... And that's just pure science.
Exclusions, medical advice, coded right to modify, client's commitment, no refunds, no chargebacks. Okay. Terms, indemnification, limited liability, medical disclaimer, performance guarantee.

flags.summary: Rep quoted a monthly instalment rate of $1,200 against a $6,000 programme - $7,200 over six months - a figure that appears nowhere in the $6,000/6mo, $9,000/12mo structure, and framed the uplift as a reason to pay up front.
evidence: So, I mean, it's not like you can't do like 1,000 per month, you know, that sort of thing?
So the thing is, you could, but it's going to be a little bit more expensive. So it's not going to be 1K per month. It's going to be 1,200.
So if, if I did 3,000 and 3,000, uh, is there any additional fees to that? No, no interest on that.

flags.summary: Prospect disclosed an undiagnosed lower-back injury from deadlifting and was sold a six-month loaded ballistic kettlebell programme without anyone asking whether a clinician had cleared him.
evidence: I was trying to deadlift and, you I built my way up to about something about 220, 245 pounds, something like that deadlift. And I think I pulled my back. So that put... me out for a little bit.
So I never got diagnosed, you know, or anything, but I did some preventative exercises strength in my lower back.
So that's what I wanted to ask. Any, any, any other, other chronic conditions?

flags.summary: Rep moved the client onto his personal WhatsApp and offered himself as the personal backstop for results, inviting the client to call him a liar if the programme fails.
evidence: All right. So I will text, I will give you my personal WhatsApp.
And if you won't see results, you can text me. Hey, hey, you freaking liar.
One last thing, as I promised. I'm a man of my words. I will text you my personal WhatsApp. And whenever you're going to be in Europe, in Poland, you need to visit me.
